acceptance: NOT A RECOVERY ACCEPTANCE: this only reports what COMMITTED, checksum-proven block-bitmap images say about the old extents after the deletion. No reuse observed is NOT proof that the bytes are intact; reuse observed is NOT proof of overwritten bytes. The candidate extent map alone is never accepted.

bitmaps.ownershipNote: clearWithoutObservedSet bits are attributed by the bound extent tree only (no proven SET bitmap image between their leaf tid and their free); they are reported, never counted as observed

boundary.deletionStartReason: coalesced: no committed intermediate unlinked image; deletion start NOT observed

window.tail: s_sequence - 1 never committed: clean unmount (jbd2_journal_destroy: j_tail_sequence = ++j_transaction_sequence), no header of that tid anywhere, s_head = the block after the newest commit

limits: commit granularity: an allocate+free of a block INSIDE one transaction leaves no bitmap trace (data may still have been written)

writes that never touch the bitmap are invisible: discard/TRIM (online 'discard' mount option or fstrim after the deletion), raw device or image-layer (qcow2) writes; the image layer must be checked separately (e.g. allocation map / sampled reads)
history before the oldest retained transaction cannot be proven absent; this check needs and verifies only tids >= the last live inode image
state after the newest journaled transaction is the current on-disk bitmap (checked separately: current-allocation.json)
block bitmap locations come from the current group descriptors (fs-stats); they are static unless the fs was resized

writers that bypass JBD2 are INVISIBLE: userspace e2fsprogs (debugfs -w, e2fsck, tune2fs, resize2fs), fuse2fs read-write, a mount by any other kernel/OS, raw block-device or image writes, and discard/TRIM (mount -o discard, fstrim / fstrim.timer); compare geometry.lastWriteTime with journal.window.newestCommitSec and check the image layer separately

ownership: each old block is attributed by the extent tree bound to proven root/index/leaf images (checksummed with the old inode generation); a bitmap SET image of a bit is only available if its group bitmap was logged between the leaf tid and the free - bits only ever seen CLEAR are counted as clearWithoutObservedSetBlocks, never as observed

coalesced model: accepted only with T == P + 1 and a proven T bitmap image of EVERY covered group with all old data + tree bits clear; the deletion start is NOT observed (deletionStartTid null) and nothing is inferred about intermediate states; an allocate+free of old blocks inside T (a very large transaction) or any later single transaction leaves no bitmap trace
NO_REUSE_OBSERVED_IN_JOURNALED_HISTORY only reflects the current flags of proven bitmap images; it is not recovery acceptance

NONE of this is a recovery acceptance: full MDBX structural check, plain-vs-hashed state / trie verification and a canonical (L1-authenticated) root remain separate gates; journal absence of reuse alone is never acceptance
